formatter.settings_source: libtmux pins ruff 0.16.10 in uv.lock and sets only target-version py310 for the formatter; the documentation surface applies line-length 60 (CODE_COLUMNS.api).
formatter.method: Each stub is a def whose body is `...`, so ruff measures four more columns before the name and five more after the last bracket than the displayed bar shows. Tests lay out the displayed bar with those columns reserved and compare it with the formatter output minus `def ` and `: ...`. Corpus stubs are the extracted Python declarations; a `*` separator is added where the model records keyword-only parameters and `*`/`**` where a trailing parameter is the catch-all, because ruff rejects the reordered defaults the model alone would give.
